stable_identity.scope: mesh peer authorization and recipient policy
stable_identity.derivation: RPC stable_peer_id_provider result, falling back to session peer_id only when unavailable
stable_identity.persistence: Stable peer identity is owned by Auth peer records and used to overwrite forwarded Tooling provider identity.
gaps: Fallback session peer_id is not guaranteed durable when the stable provider is absent
Tooling request caller_peer_id is still read directly by current policy context until G007 authority binding

stable_identity.scope: Tooling provider routing and remote snapshot partition
stable_identity.derivation: stable contract namespace for durable identity; live service_instance_id is routing instance metadata only
stable_identity.persistence: Stored with peer_id as the tooling_remote_catalog_snapshots primary key and in approval grants/tombstones.
gaps: String formula is not versioned
Compatibility callers may construct service IDs before authenticated normalization

stable_identity.scope: durable per-tool grants, tombstones, policy selectors, and catalog identity
stable_identity.persistence: Stored in ToolingToolInfo, tooling_approval_grants, remote snapshot JSON, and tooling_remote_catalog_tombstones.
gaps: Tool rename changes identity
Lossy safe_identifier can collapse distinct names
No versioned canonical namespace
No immutable tool_contract_id
No durable legacy alias or transactional re-key map

stable_identity.scope: LLM/UI callable presentation name for a remote tool
stable_identity.derivation: safe(peer display label)_safe(provider local tool name)
stable_identity.persistence: Serialized into cached remote ToolingToolInfo but should be treated as presentation only.
gaps: Peer display-name rename changes the bindable name
Only provider-local name is retained as an alias
Must never key durable policy or grants

stable_identity.scope: per-source management grouping for mesh tools
stable_identity.persistence: Serialized in ToolingToolInfo and copied into approval-grant metadata.
gaps: Stability depends on authenticated peer normalization occurring before persistence
No version marker

stable_identity.scope: per-source management grouping for built-in tools
stable_identity.persistence: Serialized in ToolingToolInfo and used by source-wide approval grants.
gaps: All core tools collapse into one group
Cannot represent required core:scheduler, core:tts, core:pomodoro functional share groups
A source-wide rule affects unrelated security domains

stable_identity.scope: per-source management grouping for plugin tools
stable_identity.derivation: local:plugin:<safe(explicit loader plugin marker or plugin/package/toolkit/module/name fallback)>
stable_identity.persistence: Serialized in ToolingToolInfo and used by source-wide approval grants.
gaps: Only selected loaders stamp an explicit _aurora_plugin_id
Module/name fallbacks can change across packaging or rename
Lossy sanitization can collide

stable_identity.scope: per-source management grouping for MCP tools
stable_identity.derivation: persistent MCP source ID plus provider-declared tool ID
stable_identity.persistence: Serialized when a tool is correctly classified as MCP and used by source-wide approval grants.
gaps: MultiServerMCPClient output is flattened without Aurora server identity stamping
ToolsManager does not mark loaded MCP tools with source/server IDs
Fallback to tool name prevents stable server grouping
Two servers can collapse or tools can be misclassified unknown
Snapshot-level shared_by_policy conflates provider catalog state and cannot express per-tool availability
No recipient-specific export-policy revision in key

stable_identity.derivation: provider_peer_id, provider_service_instance_id, and current global_tool_id columns
stable_identity.persistence: tooling_approval_grants table survives restart and unavailability.
gaps: Inherits rename and collision defects from global_tool_id
No schema hash bound directly to stable immutable tool contract ID
No alias migration substrate

stable_identity.persistence: DB RAG namespace main.tools is synchronized by name.
gaps: Rename is processed as deletion plus insertion
No immutable identity or group metadata
Cannot support durable aliases

stable_identity.derivation: immutable provider-local tool contract ID persisted across rename and restart
gaps: ToolingToolInfo has no tool_contract_id
Built-ins/plugins/MCP cannot retain policy identity across rename
No versioned aurora-tool canonical key

stable_identity.derivation: stable provider-declared functional sharing group ID
gaps: ToolingToolInfo has no share_group_id or share_group_label
Core functional groups and MCP/plugin source groups cannot be represented independently from approval policy
